english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice when spot means see or notice something.
Use this when noticing means seeing or spotting something visually.

examples.english: I can spot you waiting at the door.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gin3 dou2 nei5 hai2 mun4 hau2 dang2 gan2

examples.english: I notice a cat by the doorway.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 mun4 hau2 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 maau1
